chapter: Leading his own band in New York
title: Barnes Tavern in the Bronx: arrangements and a packed house
summary: A small place on Barnes Avenue that packed out for five or six months; he wrote much of the book.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: How did the job come up? Where was it, on Barnes Avenue?
It was on Barnes Avenue and Boston Road, Boston Post Road.
Were there a lot of clubs up in that area?
Yeah, there were quite a few clubs.
The name of it was Barnes, B-A-R-N-E-S, but it was almost like a barn. It was a small place but it got to be very popular, and we packed it.
Who put the book together for you, was it all heads mostly?
You wrote some of your own stuff?
Yeah, I wrote a lot of it. In fact I've got it here.
How long did that job last?
That job up there lasted five or six months. We did that a long time.
When that job folded-- you didn't have a manager at this point?
